entries.text: And what, may I ask, are you doing in the Boneyards?
entries.source_text: And what, may I ask, are you doing in the Boneyards?

entries.text: 你能说说你在晒骨场干什么吗？
entries.source_text: 你能说说你在晒骨场干什么吗？

entries.source_text: You ask a lot of questions.

entries.text: 你的问题很多啊。
entries.source_text: 你的问题很多啊。

entries.text: First you tell me who you are.
entries.source_text: First you tell me who you are.

entries.text: 你先告诉我你是谁。
entries.source_text: 你先告诉我你是谁。

entries.text: I'm just an explorer.
entries.source_text: I'm just an explorer.

entries.text: 我只是一个闲逛的人。
entries.source_text: 我只是一个闲逛的人。

entries.text: I'm looking for a replacement water chip for my Vault.
entries.source_text: I'm looking for a replacement water chip for my Vault.

entries.text: 我想为我的避难所找到净水芯片。
entries.source_text: 我想为我的避难所找到净水芯片。

entries.text: You learn to be careful out here. So what are you doing here?
entries.source_text: You learn to be careful out here. So what are you doing here?

entries.text: 你在这里要小心点。你是干什么的？
entries.source_text: 你在这里要小心点。你是干什么的？

entries.text: All right, fair enough. I'm called Katja. What's it matter to you?
entries.source_text: All right, fair enough. I'm called Katja. What's it matter to you?

entries.text: 好啦，为了公平，我叫卡佳，你为什么要知道？
entries.source_text: 好啦，为了公平，我叫卡佳，你为什么要知道？

entries.text: Why so hostile?
entries.source_text: Why so hostile?

entries.text: 这么敌意做什么？
entries.source_text: 这么敌意做什么？

entries.text: Hey, if you're going to be rude about it, then I'll see you later.
entries.source_text: Hey, if you're going to be rude about it, then I'll see you later.

entries.text: 你再这么粗暴，我可走了。
entries.source_text: 你再这么粗暴，我可走了。

entries.text: I'm looking for information. Can you help?
entries.source_text: I'm looking for information. Can you help?

entries.text: 我想打听点消息，你能帮我吗？
entries.source_text: 我想打听点消息，你能帮我吗？

entries.text: You might, but you're on my home turf, not vice-versa. So put up or# shut up.
entries.source_text:
You might, but you're on my home turf, not vice-versa. So put up or
# shut up.

entries.text: 随你，你在我的地盘上，而不是我在你的地盘上，所以要么说实话，要么就闭嘴。
entries.source_text: 随你，你在我的地盘上，而不是我在你的地盘上，所以要么说实话，要么就闭嘴。

entries.text: It's not important, I'm just a traveler. I need some information.
entries.source_text: It's not important, I'm just a traveler. I need some information.

entries.source_text: 我是谁不重要。我只是一个旅行者，我需要情报。

entries.text: A water purification chip? Sorry, don't know anything about that. Don't# see much of that kind of tech here in the Boneyards, except maybe the stuff# Miles works on.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: 净水芯片？抱歉，我一点都不知道。晒骨场没有什么高科技，除了麦尔斯，他经常捣腾一些高级货。
entries.source_text: 净水芯片？抱歉，我一点都不知道。晒骨场没有什么高科技，除了麦尔斯，他经常捣腾一些高级货。

entries.text: Well, thanks anyhow.
entries.source_text: Well, thanks anyhow.

entries.text: 哦，谢谢。
entries.source_text: 哦，谢谢。

entries.text: Miles? Where can I find him, and could he help?
entries.source_text: Miles? Where can I find him, and could he help?

entries.text: 麦尔斯？我怎么找到他？他会帮我吗？
entries.source_text: 麦尔斯？我怎么找到他？他会帮我吗？

entries.text: Can you tell me more about the Boneyards, then?
entries.source_text: Can you tell me more about the Boneyards, then?

entries.text: 那你再和我说说晒骨场的事情吧。
entries.source_text: 那你再和我说说晒骨场的事情吧。

entries.text: Just a traveler. I've heard that one before. Nobody comes to the# Boneyard except those Hub merchants and people looking for a quick death at the# hands of the gangs. What are you really here for?
entries.source_text:
Just a traveler. I've heard that one before. Nobody comes to the
# Boneyard except those Hub merchants and people looking for a quick death at the

entries.text: 只是一个旅行者？这种话我也听过不少了。除了来混黑道想死得快的人和哈勃城的商人，没人愿意来晒骨场。你到底是来做什么的？
entries.source_text: 只是一个旅行者？这种话我也听过不少了。除了来混黑道想死得快的人和哈勃城的商人，没人愿意来晒骨场。你到底是来做什么的？

entries.text: You're right. I'm looking for a water purification chip.
entries.source_text: You're right. I'm looking for a water purification chip.

entries.text: 你说的不错，我是来找净水芯片的。
entries.source_text: 你说的不错，我是来找净水芯片的。

entries.text: I don't need to tell you anything.
entries.source_text: I don't need to tell you anything.

entries.text: 我无可奉告。
entries.source_text: 我无可奉告。

entries.text: Damn straight. But that's a two-way street.
entries.source_text: Damn straight. But that's a two-way street.

entries.text: 太对了，我来去这里不必你管吧。
entries.source_text: 太对了，我来去这里不必你管吧。

entries.text: Maybe. You definitely aren't one of those gangland shiv-shovers. What# do you want?
entries.source_text:
Maybe. You definitely aren't one of those gangland shiv-shovers. What
# do you want?

entries.text: 也许吧，你显然不是那些地痞小混混的样子，你想做什么？

entries.text: I'm looking for a water purification chip.

entries.source_text: I need more information about the Boneyard.

entries.source_text: 我还想知道些晒骨场的事情。

entries.source_text: I need to know about the area around this city.

entries.source_text: 我想打听城里的一些地方。

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Blades?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Blades?

entries.source_text: 你能和我说说利刃帮吗？

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Rippers?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Rippers?

entries.source_text: 你能说说电锯党吗？

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Gun Runners?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Gun Runners?

entries.source_text: 你能和我说说军火商的事情吗？

entries.text: What can you tell me about the Followers?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about the Followers?

entries.text: 你能说说那些末世论者的事情吗？
entries.source_text: 你能说说那些末世论者的事情吗？

entries.text: What can you tell me about Adytum?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about Adytum?

entries.text: 你能说说内城区的事情吗？
entries.source_text: 你能说说内城区的事情吗？

entries.text: Well, it was nice chatting. Gotta go.
entries.source_text: Well, it was nice chatting. Gotta go.

entries.text: 和你聊的很愉快，再见。
entries.source_text: 和你聊的很愉快，再见。

entries.text: Miles lives in Adytum. He's a scientist, mostly working with chemistry.# If anyone could scrounge up a water chip or make a replacement, it would be him.
entries.source_text:
Miles lives in Adytum. He's a scientist, mostly working with chemistry.
# If anyone could scrounge up a water chip or make a replacement, it would be him.

entries.text: 麦尔斯住在内城区，他是个化学家。如果城里有人能制造净水芯片，那只有他了。
entries.source_text: 麦尔斯住在内城区，他是个化学家。如果城里有人能制造净水芯片，那只有他了。

entries.text: Thanks very much.
entries.source_text: Thanks very much.

entries.text: 太感谢了。
entries.source_text: 太感谢了。

entries.text: Adytum is my original home. A little too boring for me, though. It's a# fenced-off and self-sufficient town in the south end of the Boneyard, but not as# far as the Cathedral. We trade sometimes with the Hub.
entries.source_text:
Adytum is my original home. A little too boring for me, though. It's a

entries.text: 内城区是我的老家，虽然有点闷。但是自我隔绝，自给自足，它在晒骨场的南区，但是要在大教堂北边一点。我们也和哈勃城做些买卖。
entries.source_text: 内城区是我的老家，虽然有点闷。但是自我隔绝，自给自足，它在晒骨场的南区，但是要在大教堂北边一点。我们也和哈勃城做些买卖。

entries.text: I've dealt with them before. They're not too bad, as far as gangs go.# They have a hide-out in an old club, with some outposts. If you're careful you# might even be able to get some of them to talk.
entries.source_text:
I've dealt with them before. They're not too bad, as far as gangs go.
# They have a hide-out in an old club, with some outposts. If you're careful you
# might even be able to get some of them to talk.

entries.text: 我和他们打过交道。做为一个帮派，他们还不算太坏。他们的总坛在一个旧的夜总会，周围哨所不少。如果你当心点，也许还能和他们说上话。
entries.source_text: 我和他们打过交道。做为一个帮派，他们还不算太坏。他们的总坛在一个旧的夜总会，周围哨所不少。如果你当心点，也许还能和他们说上话。

entries.text: The Rippers are just plain ferocious. They're an inbred bunch that# delights in torture and murder. I stay away from them, and you should, too.# They actually put fuckin' land mines around their fortress.
entries.source_text:
The Rippers are just plain ferocious. They're an inbred bunch that
# delights in torture and murder. I stay away from them, and you should, too.
# They actually put fuckin' land mines around their fortress.

entries.text: 电锯党就是一群没人性的禽兽。他们天生就是一帮子杀人狂虐待狂。我尽量离他们远一点，你也最好别惹他们。他们居然还在总部周围布上了可恶的地雷。
entries.source_text: 电锯党就是一群没人性的禽兽。他们天生就是一帮子杀人狂虐待狂。我尽量离他们远一点，你也最好别惹他们。他们居然还在总部周围布上了可恶的地雷。

entries.text: The Gun Runners used to be a real gang, but they went soft. They started# setting up a deal where they trade weapons that they get from their victims or buy# from the Hub. Since nobody here is up for the trip to the Hub personally, they do# pretty good business, even though their prices are high.
entries.source_text:
The Gun Runners used to be a real gang, but they went soft. They started
# setting up a deal where they trade weapons that they get from their victims or buy
# from the Hub. Since nobody here is up for the trip to the Hub personally, they do

entries.text: 军火商以前也是一个黑帮，后来洗手不干了。他们用抢来的或者是从哈勃买来的枪械作买卖。这里没人愿意自己单独去哈勃城，所以他们的货很抢手，就是价格高了点。
entries.source_text: 军火商以前也是一个黑帮，后来洗手不干了。他们用抢来的或者是从哈勃买来的枪械作买卖。这里没人愿意自己单独去哈勃城，所以他们的货很抢手，就是价格高了点。

entries.text: The Followers of the Apocalypse are a group of peace-preachers who live in# a large library near the heart of the Boneyard. Why they haven't been wiped out# yet I can't say. They are lousy combatants and have no understanding of the real# world, but other than that they are polite and well-educated.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: 末世论者是一帮和平主义者，他们住在晒骨场中心区的一所大图书馆里。我也说不上为什么一直没有帮派会去铲除他们。他们是无畏的战士，对现实社会没有认同。但是除此之外，他们还算友好，比较有教养。
entries.source_text: 末世论者是一帮和平主义者，他们住在晒骨场中心区的一所大图书馆里。我也说不上为什么一直没有帮派会去铲除他们。他们是无畏的战士，对现实社会没有认同。但是除此之外，他们还算友好，比较有教养。

entries.text: The Boneyard is a pretty hostile place. I've never had the opportunity to# leave, though I suppose I'd take it. Let's see . . . just south of here you have# the Cathedral. There's some sort of cult there, but I stay away from them.# Something sinister is going on there. Also, I've heard about the trading center# called the Hub, and caravans occasionally show up, but I've never been there.
entries.source_text:
The Boneyard is a pretty hostile place. I've never had the opportunity to
# leave, though I suppose I'd take it. Let's see . . . just south of here you have
# the Cathedral. There's some sort of cult there, but I stay away from them.
# Something sinister is going on there. Also, I've heard about the trading center
# called the Hub, and caravans occasionally show up, but I've never been there.

entries.text: 晒骨场是一个充满敌意的地方。我一直没有机会离开这里，大概以后会有机会吧。嗯……再往南走就是大教堂了。那里有一群教众总在祭拜什么，我宁可离他们远一点。而且我觉得那里不干净，不吉利。我还知道贸易中心哈勃城，经常有那里的商队来这里，但我从来没去过哈勃城。
entries.source_text: 晒骨场是一个充满敌意的地方。我一直没有机会离开这里，大概以后会有机会吧。嗯……再往南走就是大教堂了。那里有一群教众总在祭拜什么，我宁可离他们远一点。而且我觉得那里不干净，不吉利。我还知道贸易中心哈勃城，经常有那里的商队来这里，但我从来没去过哈勃城。

entries.text: I don't plan to stay in this place too much longer, myself.
entries.source_text: I don't plan to stay in this place too much longer, myself.

entries.text: 我也不打算一个人在这个城市长呆。
entries.source_text: 我也不打算一个人在这个城市长呆。

entries.text: Thanks for the information.
entries.source_text: Thanks for the information.

entries.text: 谢谢你的信息。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你的信息。

entries.text: Can you tell me some more?
entries.source_text: Can you tell me some more?

entries.text: 你还知道些什么？
entries.source_text: 你还知道些什么？

entries.text: No kidding. If you're looking for another hand, I'll sign on. Better than# spending the rest of my existence in this hellhole, right?
entries.source_text:
No kidding. If you're looking for another hand, I'll sign on. Better than
# spending the rest of my existence in this hellhole, right?

entries.text: 说实话，如果你需要一个帮手，我怎么样？至少我不用在这里继续鬼混下去了，如何？
entries.source_text: 说实话，如果你需要一个帮手，我怎么样？至少我不用在这里继续鬼混下去了，如何？

entries.text: You're a welcome addition, but the desert's not much more fun.
entries.source_text: You're a welcome addition, but the desert's not much more fun.

entries.text: 我很欢迎你，但是荒漠里可没有什么好玩的。
entries.source_text: 我很欢迎你，但是荒漠里可没有什么好玩的。

entries.text: Don't worry about it. Thanks anyhow.
entries.source_text: Don't worry about it. Thanks anyhow.

entries.text: 你不用操这个心了，多谢。
entries.source_text: 你不用操这个心了，多谢。

entries.text: Can I ask some more questions first?
entries.source_text: Can I ask some more questions first?

entries.text: 那我能先问几个问题吗？
entries.source_text: 那我能先问几个问题吗？

entries.text: This area's overrun with the three gangs - the Blades, Rippers, and Gun# Runners - as well as serving as home for the Followers and for my own home,# Adytum.
entries.source_text:
This area's overrun with the three gangs - the Blades, Rippers, and Gun

entries.text: 这个地区有三大帮派－－利刃帮，电锯党和军火商－－还有末世论者以及我的老家内城区。
entries.source_text: 这个地区有三大帮派－－利刃帮，电锯党和军火商－－还有末世论者以及我的老家内城区。

entries.text: All right, looks like we've got a little ass-kicking to do!
entries.source_text: All right, looks like we've got a little ass-kicking to do!

entries.text: 很好，似乎有不少烂人可以消遣呢。
entries.source_text: 很好，似乎有不少烂人可以消遣呢。

entries.text: Look, 90% of the people in this city fall into one or more of three# categories - rapists, murderers, or thieves. I'm a thief and you actually seem# polite, so that makes me wonder, okay? Call it a survival instinct.
entries.source_text:
Look, 90% of the people in this city fall into one or more of three
# categories - rapists, murderers, or thieves. I'm a thief and you actually seem

entries.text: 要知道，城里百分之九十的人都逃不了这三种：色情狂、杀人犯和小偷，有些人还是不止一样。我是个小偷，你还算比较客气，所以我才会有些想法，明白？这叫做生存直觉。

entries.text: Sorry to step on your feet then. I guess I'll just go the hell away.
entries.source_text: Sorry to step on your feet then. I guess I'll just go the hell away.

entries.text: Thanks anyhow, but I'll be going now.
entries.source_text: Thanks anyhow, but I'll be going now.

entries.text: What's up?
